hostname.description: Lowercase hostname, in punycode if not ASCII. Must equal the record key.

providers.description: Providers that may serve the hostname. Clients write one, or two while switching provider: the new one, and the old one, which keeps serving until DNS has moved.

acmeAccount.description: URI of the ACME account that the hostname's CAA record pins issuance to, so anyone can audit the pin.

main.description: A client's claim to serve a hostname through a provider, with the policy it accepted. Lives in the client's repo, with the lowercase hostname as the record key.

acceptedPolicy.description: The provider's link.jetbridge.policy record that the client accepted. The provider serves the route only while it still accepts this record's cid.
